mechanism: Mid-training on code execution traces and agentic trajectories, then SFT and RL, of a code world model
evidence_scope: we mid-trainCWMon a large amount of observation-action trajectories from Python interpreter and agentic Docker environments, and perform extensive multi-task reasoning RL
evidence_role: We release Code World Model (CWM), a 32-billion-parameter open-weights LLM, to advance research on code generation with world models.
